capabilities: Preview notes in searchable WeChat-style themes with per-note typography settings
Copy formatted HTML with inlined styles and embedded local images
Export articles as standalone HTML files or long PNG images
Generate title covers and send drafts to WeChat Official Accounts via direct, relay or Bridge connections
Hand off content to X, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu and Weibo through the Qiaomu Clipper browser extension
disambiguation: Not a web-hosting publisher like Obsidian Publish; it formats notes and sends them as drafts to WeChat and other platforms.
extras: The plugin interface is Chinese (an English guide is linked). Previewing, formatting, copying and exporting work without any account; the optional shared Qiaomu relay limits free users to 200 relay requests per day. Sending creates drafts only, never mass-publishes; dark themes may differ from the WeChat client rendering.
motivation: The author states a note should not have to be formatted twice, so the formatting and draft steps are kept at the writing site instead of a separate editor.
problem: Obsidian has no way to preview and format a note for WeChat Official Account publishing, so authors must copy text into another editor and redo headings, spacing, quotes and code by hand.
